guide.title: Construction Company Creation Guide
guide.subtitle: All the steps to create your construction company in France, from legal status to your first projects.
guide.step1Description:
Choosing the right legal status is the first key decision. Here are the main options:

- SARL: Limited liability, minimum 2 partners. Ideal for partnerships with flexible share capital. Social charges around 45%.
- SAS: Highly flexible bylaws, president treated as employee. Perfect for raising funds or bringing in investors.
- EURL: Single-partner version of SARL, one sole partner. Good personal asset protection.
- EI (Sole Proprietorship): Simple to set up, no minimum capital. Note: unlimited personal liability.
- Auto-entrepreneur (micro-enterprise): Quick start, simplified accounting. Revenue cap at 77,700 EUR (services). Ideal for testing the market.

Consult an accountant to choose the status best suited to your personal situation and growth ambitions.
guide.step2Description:
A solid business plan is essential to convince banks and structure your business.

Key elements:
- Executive summary of your project
- Local market study (competition, demand, pricing)
- 3-year revenue forecasts
- Monthly cash flow plan (payment delays are common in construction)
- Investment needs: vehicles, tools, PPE, software
- Break-even calculation

In construction, plan for substantial working capital. Payment delays can reach 60 days or more, especially with public contracts.
guide.step3Description:
Administrative steps to officially create your company:

1. Draft the company bylaws (or business declaration for sole proprietorship/auto-entrepreneur)
2. Deposit share capital at the bank
3. Publish a legal notice in an authorized journal
4. Register your company at the commercial court registry
5. Obtain your Kbis extract (company identity card)
6. Receive your SIRET number and APE code
7. Register with the Chamber of Trades if artisanal activity

Also remember to open a dedicated professional bank account and take out mandatory insurance before starting operations.
guide.step4Description:
In construction, insurance is non-negotiable and required by law:

- RC Pro (Professional Liability Insurance): Covers damage caused to third parties during your services. Mandatory before any project.
- Decennial insurance: Mandatory for all builders. Covers construction defects for 10 years after project handover. Without it, you cannot legally operate.
- Professional vehicle insurance: For your utility vehicles and site equipment.
- Multi-risk professional insurance: Protects your premises, equipment, and stock.

Compare at least 3 quotes. Premiums vary based on your trade, projected revenue, and experience. Annual budget to plan: 3,000 to 15,000 EUR depending on activity.
guide.step5Description:
Rigorous accounting is essential in construction:

- Choose an accountant specializing in construction (they understand specifics: progress billing, retention guarantees, subcontracting)
- Set up compliant invoicing software (mandatory mentions, reverse-charge VAT for subcontracting)
- Manage your quotes precisely: lot details, payment terms, validity
- Track your cash flow daily: payment delays are the number one risk
- Anticipate VAT: simplified or standard regime depending on your revenue
- Set up per-project analytical tracking to know your real profitability

Accountant budget: 150 to 500 EUR/month depending on complexity.
guide.step6Title: Find your first clients and contracts
guide.step6Description:
Strategies to land your first contracts:

- Personal and professional network: inform friends, former colleagues, project managers
- Respond to public tenders (online markets, dematerialization platforms)
- Register on connection platforms (specialist directories, etc.)
- Subcontracting: offer your services to established general contractors
- Local presence: business cards, branded vehicle, word of mouth
- Website and local SEO (Google Business Profile)
- Partnerships with architects, project managers, and developers

Focus on the quality of your first projects: in construction, reputation is built project by project.
guide.step7Description:
Equip yourself with the right digital tools to save time from day one:

- ConductorOS: Centralize your emails, tenders, contracts, and completion reports. AI analyzes your documents and drafts your responses automatically.
- Connect your professional email (Gmail or Outlook) for automatic AI sorting and replies
- Use PDF analysis to decode tenders and extract relevant lots
- Generate your project completion reports in just a few clicks
- Track your schedule and projects from a single dashboard
- Collaborate with your suppliers directly from the platform

Go to settings to configure your company and start using all features.
